source.description: Reviewed handmade raster graphite and restrained colored-pencil process contact sheet.
source.notes: One face-free wooden rolling pin crossing one sheet of pastry dough; no labels, arrows, numbers, UI, signatures, watermarks, food, bowl, hands, lettering, or decorative border.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels lock one diagonal rolling-pin axis, one pastry-sheet footprint, two handle anchors, and one shadow before contours, grain, flour, value, or color, then reserve the final panel for reinforcement only.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one diagonal axis, two barrel ellipses, two handle routes, one pastry-sheet envelope, four flour ticks, and one broken shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: One long diagonal axis with two barrel-end ellipses
anchor_map.becomes: One cylindrical wooden rolling-pin barrel angled from upper left to lower right
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Both ellipses stay perpendicular to the same axis, the upper-left end stays slightly narrower, and the barrel keeps one scale and angle in every panel.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale axis and ellipses only in Panel 1; the barrel silhouette begins in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: Exactly two handle routes extending from the barrel ends
anchor_map.becomes: Exactly two tapered wooden handles attached through two narrow collars
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Each handle remains centered on its original barrel end and points along the same diagonal axis without floating or changing length.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open routes only until the handles and collars are wrapped in Panel 3.

anchor_map.early_mark: One broad pastry-sheet envelope beneath the center and lower edge of the barrel
anchor_map.becomes: One irregular rectangular sheet of rolled pastry dough partly covered by the barrel
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The dough remains behind the barrel, with its far edge visible above and its near edge visible below; no finished dough line passes through the barrel footprint.
anchor_map.construction_note: The envelope reserves the overlap in Panel 1; the dough contour is connected only around the rolling-pin footprint in Panel 2.

final_elements.name: rolling pin dough handle flour and shadow construction guides
final_elements.description: One diagonal axis, two barrel ellipses, two handle routes, one pastry-sheet envelope, four flour ticks, and one broken shadow route.

final_elements.name: cylindrical barrel and rolled pastry sheet
final_elements.description: One long wooden barrel and one irregular rectangular dough sheet behind it with a stable central overlap.

final_elements.name: two attached handles and two collars
final_elements.description: Exactly two tapered handles and exactly two narrow collars attached to the barrel ends.

final_elements.name: barrel end rings dough thickness and three wood-grain curves
final_elements.description: Two barrel-end rings, one short dough-thickness edge, and exactly three curved grain marks following the cylinder.

final_elements.name: two paper highlights four flour dashes and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Exactly two open-paper wood highlights, exactly four small flour dashes around the dough, and one broken graphite shadow.

final_elements.name: graphite value and restrained honey cream and cool-gray color map
final_elements.description: Directional graphite, honey-brown wood, warm-cream dough, pale flour, and cool-gray shadow mapped before the finish.

final_elements.name: cylindrical depth dough folds and paper tooth
final_elements.description: Small established barrel shadows, collar accents, two shallow dough folds, and visible paper highlights and graphite grain.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The pastry-sheet keeper contour stops at both sides of the reserved barrel footprint so no finished dough line is erased when the barrel is connected.

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, drifting diagonal axis, or a rolling pin that changes viewpoint, scale, barrel length, or end-ellipse angle.
Reject missing or extra barrels, handles, collars, dough sheets, grain curves, highlights, flour dashes, folds, or a handle that floats away from its barrel end.
Reject a pastry keeper line drawn through the barrel footprint or a final that introduces food, a bowl, hands, utensils, lettering, or props absent earlier.
Reject vector-like linework, glossy rendering, repeated darkened tracings, labels, arrows, numbers, text, signatures, or watermarks.
